apps.name: Conduit
apps.subtitle: Native client for Open WebUI & Ollama
apps.localizedDescription: Conduit is a native, open-source iOS and Android client for Open WebUI, direct OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama and Hermes. Chat with your own self-hosted local models or API-backed ones with a polished SwiftUI interface — conversations stay in sync, code blocks render properly, and your data never touches a third-party server.
apps.versionDescription:
Conduit 4.2.0 | conduit

## What's Changed
* Add Open WebUI client parity and Advanced UI controls by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/807
* Make everyday Open WebUI features available without Advanced and polish the new screens by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/808
* CI: run steps in parallel, cache Gradle, and trim setup by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/810
* Add Flutter control facades and a narrow platform UI vocabulary (1/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/811
* Enforce the platform UI seam with a shrinking allow-list (2/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/812
* Route settings selection controls through platform UI (3/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/813
* Use platform UI chips for reactions, decisions and folder icons (4/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/814
* Use platform UI controls for launcher loading and Direct retries (5/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/815
* Keep the chosen reasoning effort when the model selector is reopened by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/821
* Store Open WebUI servers and accounts in one registry (1/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/817
* Keep several Open WebUI accounts signed in and switch between them (2/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/818
* Switch, add and sign out of Open WebUI accounts from the profile (3/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/819
* Reach an Open WebUI server through whichever of its addresses answers (4/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/820
* Save several named Hermes connections and switch between them by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/816
* Stop downloading whole chats again when they open by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/826
* Keep the docked iPad sidebar visible to VoiceOver by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/827
* Put every account and connection on one Accounts page, and add them from one sheet by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/828
* Support Open WebUI 0.12 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/843
* Talk with a realtime voice in calls on Open WebUI, Hermes and Direct by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/842


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.9...v4.2.0

compatibility.notes: Official IPA (conduit.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases; the debug-flavored bundle (app.cogwheel.conduit.debug) is excluded. Requires a self-hosted Open WebUI/Ollama server or your own API endpoints.
